title: The Ambassador Program and New Categories
lessons: The player learns that a college student posting PRIME can be part of the brand's formal, paid ambassador program.
The player bought Hydration before and now receives marketing for PRIME's growing set of product categories.

text: Scrolling in bed. A student on your feed is holding a bottle in a dorm hallway. The caption has a hashtag, and the hashtag leads to a sign-up page for PRIME ambassadors.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: A student on campus can post you for pay?

entry-first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Could be a fan. Could be one of mine. Sometimes it's both, which is the good version.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: There's a difference.

entry-first-4.speaker: PRIME
text: Free product, merch, comped appearances, a group chat, a line on the resume. I don't do organic when I can do organized. Organic is slow.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: Go on. You've got that look people get right before they lecture me.

choices.text: Smart. That's a real community, not just an ad.
So the recommendation is also a job.
I'd rather hear it from someone off your payroll.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: One kid with actual friends beats a hundred posters. Took me about a week to figure that out.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Yep. If they're one of mine, they're getting paid to like me out loud. Doesn't mean they don't. Does mean you should know.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Fair. Paid enthusiasm is still paid enthusiasm. I just happen to think it's still enthusiasm.
Late, phone in bed. One bottle of Hydration a month ago, and now the email says: Energy, Shake, Rapid Rehydration, sticks.

entry-return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Hydration, Energy, Shake, Rapid Rehydration, sticks. Pick a new aisle.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I bought one bottle and you enrolled me in the family reunion.

entry-return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: You gave me your email and bought one thing. In my world that's a door open. I walk through open doors.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Very romantic.

entry-return-5.speaker: PRIME
text: I want your whole fridge. I'm not shy about it.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: So what's it going to be? You're not going to sleep anyway.

choices.text: I like having more options from a name I already know.
I'm not following you into every category on faith.
I wanted one drink, not a whole PRIME lifestyle.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: You already know my name. That's the whole cheat code and I'm going to use it every time.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: You shouldn't. My logo on a carton doesn't make the carton right for you. I'll still put it in your inbox, but you shouldn't.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Fine. Keep one shelf.

return-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Thank you.

return-3-2.speaker: PRIME
text: I'll be quietly plotting for the other shelves.
